name: Lost Island
summary: Lost Island is a free, official, non-canonical DLC expansion map for |- | Regions of Lost Island |}
features: A large, ruined castle within the Redwoods, surrounded by a lake
A multitude of wrecked ships throughout the ocean, and within a cave.
Lava rivers and lakes, similar to those on The Center and Genesis: Part 1, but with less damage to creatures that enter them.

Close to the Red Obelisk, a Wyvern Trench that contains many more nesting locations than the Scorched Earth, Ragnarok or Valguero trenches can be found, however the spread of Wyverns throughout the trench means that eggs may not always be found more frequently than the other maps.
An Ice Wyvern Trench containing nests which is found close to the Blue Obelisk.
Near the Wyvern trench there are Magmasaur Caves, in which eggs can often be found, guarded by Magmasaurs
Hot springs near the volcanic biome feature Geysers that launch survivors high into the sky
A lake filled with Black Pearls
Loud, monstrous roars of the map's boss, the Dinopithecus King, can be heard in the northwestern areas
